title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Platform Intelligence
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs. We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day. The work sits where research meets product. We work with new models before they are public. When a model gains a new ability, we work out what it should look like as an API, build it, and ship it to developers on our own platform and on cloud platforms. Those decisions shape how developers first use each model. We also own API versioning and the evals that tell us a capability works in production. What you'll do You'll lead the design, build, and operation of API capabilities used by developers around the world. You'll work with research to understand what a new model can do and turn that into an interface that is simple, durable, and hard to misuse. You'll lead the API side of new model launches. You'll plan the work, track readiness across teams, resolve the issues that come up late, and see the launch through on the day. Between launches, you'll make the next one faster and safer. You'll set technical direction for work that spans several teams, write clear design proposals, review API designs from other teams, and mentor engineers on the team. Representative projects Lead API readiness for a Claude model launch, so that every feature works on day one across our API, SDKs, docs, and cloud partners Take a new model ability from research prototype to public API feature, from interface design to production rollout Build and operate tools such as web search and code execution under real traffic Automate the manual parts of a model launch Build the evals that catch a capability regression before a launch You might be a good fit if you: Have led technical projects that spanned several teams, from design through launch and operation Have designed and operated production distributed systems where correctness, latency, and availability all matter Have strong product sense and care about API design and developer experience Make sound technical decisions with incomplete information, as models and priorities change close to a launch Explain tradeoffs clearly to research, product, and go-to-market partners, including non-engineers Make the engineers around you better through design review and mentoring Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build, and review software Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI Strong candidates may also have: Building public APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms Working with large language models, including tool use, agents, or evals Running launches or migrations with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams Building tools for agents, such as search or code execution Storage, memory, or context systems at scale Integrating with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.
